description: SXT-036 parameter-corner stimulus: the MIDI source corners of ms_velocity / ms_releasevelocity (1, 63, 64, 126, 127 on note-on; 0, 1, 63, 126, 127 on note-off) carried by overlapping voices, so the per-instance-state rule also holds at the corners; note 72 carries velocity 127 AND release velocity 127, the only combination that drives BOTH source words to full scale in one voice (the worst-case per-destination route-sum corner); model/voice-local sequence (SXT-034 pattern)
notes: Note-on velocity 0 is deliberately ABSENT: in MIDI a note-on with velocity 0 is a note-off, and whether the pinned engine ever constructs a voice with fvel == 0 is an engine-behaviour question that needs the oracle (#96/#232). The vel_q = 0 word is still exercised, through the release-velocity register, which the pinned engine itself initializes to 0 at voice construction (SurgeVoice ctor: releaseVelocitySource.set_output(0, 0)). Velocities 1/63/126 give ODD Q10.21 source words (16513 / 1040319 / 2080639) and 127 gives the exact word 2^21; the odd words are what make a depth of exactly 0.5 an exact round-half-up tie in the qmul.
